messages:
nora (data-eng): FYI — spotted a sharp dip in NA usage ingress starting ~2026-03-16T03:00Z. Correlates with the nightly retention/compact job. Looks like a compaction window pruned active eventstore partitions before they were forwarded to the ledger: ~18M tokens missing in the ingest counts. Head logs:
```
[2026-03-16T03:01:08Z] retention-job-03: compaction triggered for partition=us-east-1-2026-03-15-22
[2026-03-16T03:01:22Z] eventstore: prune completed -> deleted 142 files, last-offset=98765432
[2026-03-16T03:02:00Z] ingest-forwarder: WARNING: missing upstream offsets [98765300..98765432]
```

jessica (support): yikes. Are invoices/dashboards already showing the lower numbers? any customer-facing impact? :thinking_face:

liam (billing): we have several invoices that closed on 2026-03-15/03-16. If token events never made it to the ledger those invoices will undercount usage. Need a quick list of affected org_ids + estimated token delta per billing window so we can surface credits/adjustments.

nora (data-eng): working it. I dumped a quick org-level delta from the retention window — prepping a CSV to S3 (s3://redwood-internal/incidents/1917001234/delta.csv). Plan:
1) run replay from eventstore for the missing offset range into a staging ledger
2) run checksum + dedupe against staging vs production ledger
3) replay into production ingest with `--dedupe=true` and small parallelism

Example dry-run command:
```
./tools/replay \
  --from-offset 98765300 \
  --to-offset 98765432 \
  --source eventstore://us-east-1/partition-22 \
  --target staging-ledger \
  --dedupe true \
  --max-workers 8
```

kai (eng-runtime): note for replay: prefer `--preserve-order=false` to avoid huge KV cache blowup on the runtime nodes. Also bump `--max-workers` to 12 if you can run on c5-large workers; that'll keep tail latency reasonable. Watch the token-window SLOs while replaying — heavy replays can surface old model timeouts.

nora (data-eng): good call. we'll do dry-run to staging with `--preserve-order=false` and run the checksum tool before touching prod:
```
python tools/checksum.py --source staging-ledger --compare prod-ledger --window 2026-03-15T22:00Z/2026-03-16T06:00Z
```

sre-bot: alert: retention-job-03 triggered compaction at 2026-03-16T03:01Z (job-id c7f9). Link: https://sre.monitoring/alerts/retention-job-03/c7f9

jessica (support): can we get a short customer comms template? We'll proactively message any orgs with >5% invoice variance. Put draft here and I'll iterate.

liam (billing): policy note: automated credit < $50, needs finance approval above that. If delta per org > $500, flag for leadership review. Need estimated deltas by EOD to queue adjustments.

nora (data-eng): starting dry-run now. ETA ~2.5h for replay + checksum. Will post reconciled token counts and the final replay command we'll run against prod. :white_check_mark:
